subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core client-capability-gated tool seam plus a Canvas-owned inline widget tool, or keep show_widget-style rendering outside core?
rationale: The request adds a public plugin/tool API and a model-authored HTML/SVG rendering surface with security and product-scope implications that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve scoped core seam and Canvas tool
options.body: Accept the direction, require the client-capability contract plus Canvas sandbox/CSP/quota design, and let implementation proceed after focused design review.

options.title: Split seam before renderer
options.body: Land only the generic client-capability-gated tool contract first, then decide the `show_widget` tool separately after plugin authors can use the seam.

options.title: Keep renderer ClawHub-only
options.body: Reject the core/widget direction for now and ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package, accepting that surface-gated tools remain unsolved.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped core seam and Canvas tool
recommendation.body: Accept the direction, require the client-capability contract plus Canvas sandbox/CSP/quota design, and let implementation proceed after focused design review.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest merged history on the current Control UI rich-output/embed boundary that the proposed widget flow extends.
